summary: Reproduced the flat non-streaming OpenAI error body in the prepared checkout and changed OpenAIServingBase.create_error_response to emit the standard {"error": {...}} envelope. Added a regression for the reported max_tokens/param case and independent coverage for a 422 response and streaming/non-streaming parity. Updated existing tests that intentionally inspect this shared response format.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-202ee938099e/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... call create_error_response for 400 and 422 and create_streaming_error_response ... PY (recorded in investigation.md)
tests.what_was_measured: Before the fix, the actual checked-out implementation returned top-level object/message/type/param/code for non-streaming 400 and 422 responses, while the streaming response had an error envelope.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-202ee938099e/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_base.py (run temporarily against the base implementation)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: all 3 tests failed because the non-streaming body lacked the error envelope.
Passing-after focused and caller coverage: 160 tests and 68 subtests passed, including reported-shape, non-default 422, streaming parity, chat validation, and transcription error paths.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-202ee938099e/venv/bin/python - <<'PY' ... feed create_error_response through httpx.MockTransport to openai.OpenAI chat.completions.create ... PY (recorded in investigation.md)
tests.what_was_measured: The installed official OpenAI SDK raised BadRequestError and preserved the max_tokens parameter and server error message from the corrected envelope.
No whitespace errors in the patch.

remaining_limitations: No live SGLang model server was launched and no model weights were loaded. The validation covers the actual shared serving serializer, real chat/transcription callers in unit tests, and official OpenAI SDK parsing through an in-process HTTP transport; it does not claim model architecture, semantic accuracy, or distributed serving coverage.

The defect and correction are deterministic Python HTTP response serialization. No GPU kernel, model execution, or numerical output is involved, so the assigned gfx950 was not used as unrelated evidence.
The prepared Python environment does not contain black or isort, so those formatter checks could not be run; git diff --check passed.
The matching upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33534 remains open and blocked at investigation time; this mirror change independently verifies the same narrow correction.
